AD-01A amendment written to docs/architecture/03a-lead-state-machine-decision-amendment.md (STATUS: PROPOSED — NOT APPROVED). Five resolutions, all recommendations requiring owner approval: (1) Q1 — do NOT add 'Pending' as a fifth persisted lifecycle state; keep four values (New/Follow-up/Success/Dump) and model 'who owes the next move' as an R4-configurable qualifier on the follow-up commitment, yielding a derived 'blocked' Action Feed bucket. AD-01's own orthogonality test decides it: a lead can be in Follow-up AND externally blocked simultaneously, so it is not a lifecycle value. Spec silence noted — §09 names Pending but defines it nowhere. (2) Q4 — Success = §20 Stage 3 'Booked' after builder-side verification. CONFIRMS the owner's provisional preference, but on independent grounds (§06's Customer boundary keys on a *confirmed* booking; §21's snapshot; §20's completion language; §17's prohibition), not by deference. Noted: §40/§32 key CP commission on payment milestones, so Q4 has no commission consequence; AD-01's Q6 narrows to §35 cancellations only. (3) Q7 — three-dimension classification framework on the R4 reason master: Opportunity validity class (invalid / redundant / commercial loss / disqualified / administrative), Responsibility locus (source-or-CP / prospect / builder-product-or-process / none), Recoverability posture; engagement depth derived from activity history, not stored. No reason values proposed. Reason mandatory on closed-without-conversion terminal states (§95 resolves the §13 one-tap tension). (4) Sync/verification axis — SPLIT. AD-01 §5.1 contains a correctness defect: 'every lead created online is Verified at creation' contradicts §09/§11, which apply duplicate and clash detection to all leads, hiding the commercially decisive online-lead-vs-CP-claim case. Transport sync is not a lead axis at all (it collapses to immutable offline-capture provenance plus the gate's 'not yet run'; live transport state belongs on the §47 queued-operation record); the verification/clash gate is a lead axis applying to every lead; attribution conflicts route to the existing attribution entity, dissolving the 'Sync Conflict' catch-all. §48 (must show sync state) vs §11 (must hide competing claims) makes the merge structurally impossible. (5) Assignment axis — ELIMINATE; minimal persisted footprint is ZERO axis values. Unassigned/Assigned derive from the §10 Handler reference; Pending Enrichment becomes a persisted task plus a derived completeness check; Reassignment Pending is not built (no spec defines a reassignment approval — Rule 1). AD-01's reversibility argument does not rescue this axis because §06's Assignment Log already records the history, unlike the sync gate. Net: AD-01's Alternative C stands but with three persisted axes reduced to two. Four new open questions raised (N-1..N-4), no other blocker touched, no SQL/schema/migration. (3) Q5-C: visibility keys on ENTITLEMENT, never on CUSTODY — three independent inputs, fail-closed, evaluated per (viewer, lead, episode): I1 participation (worked that episode), I2 management breadth (existing grant mechanism, M-7), I3 conferral (explicit authorized act). Current-handler identity is not an input at all.
